newEntriesNeeded.title: TAGMANAGEMENTTMP Object
newEntriesNeeded.principle: TAGMANAGEMENTTMP is a custom/external object used for tag management operations including alarm updates and class name updates.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Always PML RELOAD OBJECT before creating instances of TAGMANAGEMENTTMP to ensure latest method definitions are loaded.
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
PML RELOAD OBJECT TAGMANAGEMENTTMP
!tagMgmt = object TAGMANAGEMENTTMP()
!tagMgmt.GetMappingData()
!tagMgmt.ClassNameUpdate(boolean)
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:

pitfalls: Skipping PML RELOAD OBJECT may cause stale method definitions.
ClassNameUpdate expects a boolean argument; omitting it causes runtime error.

newEntriesNeeded.title: PML RELOAD OBJECT Directive
newEntriesNeeded.principle: PML RELOAD OBJECT reloads a PML object definition from its source, ensuring the latest version is available for instantiation.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use PML RELOAD OBJECT before creating instances of custom or addon objects that may have been updated.
pitfalls: RELOAD OBJECT only affects objects loaded via PML; objects defined in .pmlobj files may need different reload mechanisms.
Repeated reloads without cleanup may cause memory leaks for some object types.
